columns.name: amount_minor
columns.customConstraints: NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor != 0 AND (kind = 'ADJUSTMENT' OR amount_minor > 0))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "office_lawyers" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "bar_registration_number" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LAWYER', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "photo_document_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "phone_secondary" TEXT NULL, "whatsapp_number" TEXT NULL, "national_id" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "referral_source" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "whatsapp_consent_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', "consent_recorded_at" INTEGER NULL, "consent_recorded_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "consent_source" TEXT NULL, "assigned_lawyer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cases" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "case_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "opponent_name" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'جارية', "status_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "session_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "court_location" TEXT NOT NULL, "circle_number" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_notes" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INTERNAL', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "case_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "client_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_documents" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_file_path" TEXT NULL, "storage_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEGACY', "checksum" TEXT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "uploaded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "client_lawyers" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "lawyer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "assignment_role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RESPONSIBLE', "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "change_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_lawyers" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "lawyer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "assignment_role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (assignment_role IN ('LEAD', 'ASSISTANT')), "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "change_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_credentials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lawyer_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "pin_verifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm" TEXT NOT NULL, "parameters_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "failed_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" INTEGER NULL, "must_change_pin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("must_change_pin" IN (0, 1)), "credentials_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "actor_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_owner_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_transaction_reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions (id), "source_amount_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposed_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "rounding_residual" TEXT NULL, "conversion_error" TEXT NULL, "has_subcent_precision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_subcent_precision" IN (0, 1)), "is_negative" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_negative" IN (0, 1)), "ownership_mismatch" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("ownership_mismatch" IN (0, 1)), "review_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "reviewed_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "reviewed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fee_agreements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK(currency = 'EGP'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('FIXED','HOURLY','MILESTONE')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "terms" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "client_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK(currency = 'EGP'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "case_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('FEE','PAYMENT','EXPENSE_ADVANCE','DISCOUNT','REFUND','ADJUSTMENT')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor != 0 AND (kind = 'ADJUSTMENT' OR amount_minor > 0)), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "agreement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES fee_agreements (id), "attributed_lawyer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK(currency = 'EGP'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "agreement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fee_agreements (id), "charge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_ledger_entries (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK(currency = 'EGP'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_ledger_entries (id), "charge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_ledger_entries (id), "installment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES installments (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "office_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK(currency = 'EGP'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_receipts" ("number" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_ledger_entries (id), "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "void_reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_classifications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "review_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES legacy_transaction_reviews (id), "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "ledger_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES client_ledger_entries (id), "office_expense_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES office_expenses (id), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "reviewed_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report_templates" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "case_reports" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "case_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('REPORT','RECEIPT','STATEMENT')), "receipt_number" INTEGER NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_content" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "includes_finance" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("includes_finance" IN (0, 1)), "previewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generated_documents" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES case_reports (id), "format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(format IN ('PDF','PNG')), "page_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("report_id", "format", "page_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "share_attempts" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES case_reports (id), "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipient_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "artifact_hashes_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('STARTED','OPENED','CANCELLED','FAILED','UNAVAILABLE','SAVED','COPIED')), "actual_target" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "user_confirmed_sent_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_templates" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("name", "version"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_documents" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES word_templates (id), "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "case_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cases (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "word_share_attempts" ("updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES word_documents (id), "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES office_lawyers (id), "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('STARTED','OPENED','SAVED','CANCELLED','FAILED','UNAVAILABLE')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
